resources.string: Private keys and host fingerprints scoped to this profile, stored on the device (keys encrypted). Host verification happens here; interactive sessions open in the “SSH terminal” tab.
Activate a profile to manage its SSH keys and trusted hosts.
No key imported for this profile.
Delete key “%1$s” from this device? The private PEM will be erased permanently.
No host pinned for this profile.
Remove the fingerprint for %1$s? The next connection will require a new explicit confirmation.
Paste the contents of a known_hosts file. Hashed hosts, wildcards, markers and conflicts are rejected and reported, never applied.
Erase every host fingerprint of this profile? Each next connection will require an explicit confirmation.
Expected public key line: type then base64 data.
A key already uses this name.
Encrypted PKCS#8 keys are not supported: convert the key to OpenSSH format (ssh-keygen -p -f key).
Unreadable SSH vault: corrupted data or missing encryption key.
Probes the host with an SSH handshake (no credential, no command) and confronts the presented key with this profile’s pinned fingerprints.
Host unreachable or SSH key not retrieved.
Fingerprint verified: the presented key matches the existing pin.
First contact: compare this fingerprint with a trusted source (Ploi console, server operator) before pinning.
WARNING: the presented key differs from the existing pin. Possible interception or reinstalled server — continue only after out-of-band verification.
Replace the pin for %1$s with the presented key? Confirm only if you verified the new fingerprint out of band.
No public key found in this PEM: also paste the OpenSSH public line.
Passphrase-protected (asked at each connection, never saved).

Direct phone-to-server SSH terminal, with no intermediary. The host key is checked against this profile’s pinned fingerprints before any credential is sent; an unknown or changed host blocks the connection.
No destination yet. Open a session from a server or with “New session”.
The private key is created on this phone and sealed in the encrypted vault; it never leaves the device.
Key generated and selected. Authorize it on the server before connecting.
Adds public key “%1$s” to the server through the Ploi API (server SSH keys). Propagation may take a few seconds.
Authorize key “%1$s” for user %2$s? It grants shell access to this server.
Key sent to Ploi. Connect with the chosen system user.
Agent and X11 forwarding are disabled. Passwords and passphrases stay in memory only for the connection attempt.
Host not pinned: use “Verify a host”, compare the fingerprint, pin it, then reconnect. No credential was sent.
WARNING: the host key changed. Connection blocked before any authentication; verify out of band before re-pinning.
The server refused authentication (user, password or unauthorized key).
SSH negotiation failed with this server.
Connection ended by the server or lost.
